// Configuration — reads webhook query/params, applies defaults.
const incoming = $json.query || $json.params || {};

const city = incoming.city || 'Demo City';
const searchQueries = (incoming.searchQueries || 'restaurant,resto bar,traiteur')
  .split(',')
  .map(q => q.trim())
  .filter(q => q.length > 0);
